inputs.prompt: One continuous view through a wet window of a single woman inside the room. She has a short dark wavy bob, an olive knitted cardigan and an ivory blouse. She sits at a walnut table looking down toward her laptop, breathing quietly. The camera holds this same composition. Fine beads of water on the foreground glass, soft rainy daylight and a warm lamp behind her. Exactly one human figure stays inside the room for the whole shot.
